items.kw: A male bird flies thousands of kilometers for 15 years, only to be reunited with his partner.
items.desc: An elderly Croatian man saved a wounded white stork, Malena, who could no longer fly. A male stork, Ak, fell in love with her. "Om Jai Laxmi Mata" is the universal and most revered devotional aarti dedicated to Goddess Lakshmi, the consort of Lord Vishnu and the supreme bestower of wealth, fortune, and spiritual abundance. items.desc: When Efren Ramirez stepped into the role of Pedro Sanchez in the 2004 independent comedy Napoleon Dynamite, few involved in the low-budget production could have predicted the cultural phenomenon it would become. Filmed on a modest budget of roughly $400,000 in the small town of Preston, Idaho, the project relied on deadpan delivery and awkward silences, a comedic style that demanded remarkable restraint from its cast.
